fact_check.claim: Cornell does not recommend a bank
fact_check.note: Page says International Services doesn't recommend any particular bank.

fact_check.claim: You don't need an SSN to open a bank account
fact_check.note: Page: "You don't need an SSN to open a bank account, rent an apartment, or get a credit card."

fact_check.claim: An SSN is only available with authorized employment
fact_check.note: Source says "In general" international students need authorized employment to be eligible, and lists exceptions (e.g. J-2 dependents with a USCIS work card). Article states it as absolute.

fact_check.claim: Local account helps write checks to off-campus businesses that may not accept out-of-town checks; bank reps on campus at orientation
fact_check.note: Both stated on the Bursar page.

fact_check.claim: Bursar lists banks with branches outside Ithaca so you can keep the account
fact_check.note: Page says a few community banks have branches elsewhere; it does not name which.

fact_check.claim: Bursar lists nine institutions with phone numbers but no fees, addresses or SSN rules
fact_check.note: Nine banks with phones; no fees or SSN rules. Page lists phones only, no addresses.

fact_check.claim: Direct deposit: 24 hours after refund generated, else check; direct deposit 2-3 business days; check 7-10 business days after printing
fact_check.note: All matched.

fact_check.claim: Nelnet Business Services with NetID, choose Direct Deposit, enter routing and account numbers
fact_check.note: Matches; page also requires Two-Step Login.

fact_check.claim: Alternatives: $2 one-time enrollment, $5 stays on deposit, no minimum for checking, $2 monthly fee waived without paper statements
fact_check.note: All matched.

fact_check.claim: Alternatives ATMs surcharge-free at over 30,000 through CO-OP Network
fact_check.note: Matches. The table cell has no inline link to this source.

fact_check.claim: Alternatives requires only a lease with a local address (SSN rule per Cornell)
fact_check.note: Cornell page says so. Alternatives' own page also lists ID requirements, which the article covers separately.

fact_check.claim: Alternatives ID: state driver's license, learner's permit, non-driver ID or U.S. passport; proof of address: paycheck stub, utility bill or signed lease
fact_check.note: Matches (unexpired, government-issued).

fact_check.claim: Alternatives membership requires living in a listed county; Tompkins is one
fact_check.note: Tompkins is in the list of 17 counties.

fact_check.claim: Tompkins: no monthly fee; $3.50 paper statements; $0 to open in branch, $25 online
fact_check.note: All matched.

fact_check.claim: Tompkins: no fee for non-Tompkins ATMs / 'its ATM policy helps if you travel'
fact_check.note: Tompkins charges no fee itself, but the page does not address fees charged by the ATM owner. Article implies free use anywhere.

fact_check.claim: Tompkins student account without an SSN only for students up to age 25
fact_check.note: Matches Cornell page.

fact_check.claim: Tompkins: full or part-time student; reverts to Direct Checking terms at 26; age 25 or younger
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Bursar lists Tompkins; article names it Tompkins Bank & Trust
fact_check.note: Bursar and Cornell International say 'Tompkins Trust Company'; the bank's own page names Tompkins Bank & Trust. Not a conflict in facts, but the article does not explain the naming.

fact_check.claim: CFCU is now Beginnings Credit Union
fact_check.note: No fetched page says CFCU was renamed Beginnings. Only evidence is the matching phone number (607-257-8500) on both Bursar and Beginnings pages. No source link in the article for the rename.

fact_check.claim: CFCU: debit card and online banking without an SSN or ITIN
fact_check.note: Matches for 'CFCU'.

fact_check.claim: Beginnings: more than 85,000 surcharge-free ATMs; student checking offered; fees not listed
fact_check.note: 'over 85,000 surcharge-free ATMs'; page lists no fees.

fact_check.claim: Beginnings membership: live, work, worship, attend school or own a business in service area; keep $5 in share account
fact_check.note: Matches (33-county service area).

fact_check.claim: Beginnings phone 607-257-8500
fact_check.note: Call Center number matches.

fact_check.claim: Ithaca Community Bank: accounts, debit cards, online banking without SSN
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Cornell's Bursar lists Ithaca Community Bank as Community Bank
fact_check.note: Bursar lists 'Community Bank' (866-764-8638); no source equates it with Ithaca Community Bank. Unsupported identification.

fact_check.claim: M&T: debit cards and online banking without SSN
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Bank of America: driver's license and passport, in person; nearest location Syracuse
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Bursar lists Bank of America, M&T, Key and Citizens
fact_check.note: All four are on the list.

fact_check.claim: Open in person 'since Bank of America and some others require it'
fact_check.note: Only Bank of America is stated to require in-person. 'Some others' is unsourced.

fact_check.claim: Alternatives asks for proof of a physical street address (FAQ)
fact_check.note: Page lists proof of address documents; the phrase 'physical street address' and the claim that Cornell pages do not say whether you can open before arrival are not in the sources.

beats_top.query: cornell student bank account best bank Ithaca students
beats_top.why: The #1 result is a bare list of nine banks with phone numbers and no fees, SSN rules or comparison; our page answers the SSN question in the first paragraph and compares fees and requirements. Non-Cornell listicles for the query are national, not Ithaca-specific.
changes: Fix the unsourced identifications (CFCU = Beginnings, Ithaca Community Bank = Community Bank) so the table is trustworthy.
Qualify the Tompkins ATM claim and the SSN-only-with-employment claim so no student is misled.
Add Alternatives' Ithaca address and hours (from its checking page) so the checklist is actionable.

fixes: Change 'CFCU (now Beginnings Credit Union)' in the table: either remove the claim that CFCU is now Beginnings, or add a source link that states the rename. Until one is found, write 'CFCU (the Bursar and Cornell International list CFCU; Beginnings Credit Union at the same phone number 607-257-8500 publishes the 85,000-ATM figure)' and make clear the Cornell SSN rule is stated for 'CFCU'.

Remove 'Cornell's Bursar lists it as Community Bank' for Ithaca Community Bank, or reword to: 'The Bursar's list includes a bank called Community Bank (866-764-8638); we could not confirm it is the same as Ithaca Community Bank.' Source https://bursar.cornell.edu/students-parents/student-resources/local-banking-services

Tompkins ATM: change 'no fee for non-Tompkins ATMs' to 'Tompkins charges no fee for using non-Tompkins ATMs; the ATM's owner may still charge its own fee'. Change 'Its ATM policy helps if you travel' to match. Source https://www.tompkinsbank.com/student-checking-101

Change 'An SSN is only available with authorized employment' to 'In general, international students need authorized employment to be eligible to apply for an SSN; there are exceptions such as J-2 dependents with a USCIS work card'. Source https://international.globallearning.cornell.edu/employment-and-taxes/apply-ssn

In checklist step 3, change 'since Bank of America and some others require it' to 'since Bank of America requires it (Cornell's page)'. Source https://international.globallearning.cornell.edu/getting-started/your-first-week-0

Add an inline link to https://www.alternatives.org/accounts/checking/ for the 30,000 ATM figure in the Alternatives table row, and add Alternatives' Ithaca branch address (125 N. Fulton Street) and hours (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 9-5; Wed 9-3; Sat 10-1) from that page.

In the FAQ, change 'proof of a physical street address' to 'proof of address (a paycheck stub, utility bill or signed lease)' per https://www.alternatives.org/accounts/open-an-account/, and drop or soften 'Cornell's pages do not say' unless checked.
